name: ATK_TECH_ASSET_ATTRIBUTES
description: ATK_TECH_ASSET_ATTRIBUTES contains the attributes of the SDO and parameters of the service operation.

columns.name: TECH_ASSET_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the technology asset attribute.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TECH_ASSET_ID
columns.description: ID of the technology asset. Refers to the TECHNOLOGY_ASSET_ID in ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the name of an asset attribute.

columns.name: DISPLAY_LABEL
columns.description: Identifies the display label of an SDO attribute

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Identifies the description of an asset attribute.

columns.name: DATATYPE
columns.description: Identifies the primitive and fusion complex datatypes. This doesn't include the Fusion Service SDO datatypes.

columns.name: DATATYPE_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Fusion SDO datatypes. The namespace of the Sdo datatypes should start with either http://xmlns.oracle.com/apps/   or http://xmlns.oracle.com/oracle/apps/.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: Identifies the STATE of an asset attribute. The state can be STANDARD, NEW or CUSTOMIZED.

columns.name: QUERYABLE_YN
columns.description: Identifies the Queryable property of an SDO asset attribute

columns.name: UPDATEABLE_YN
columns.description: Identifies the updateable property of an SDO attribute

columns.name: REQUIRED_YN
columns.description: Identifies the updateable property of an SDO attribute

columns.name: UNBOUNDED_YN
columns.description: Identifies the list property of an SDO attribute or the list property a service operation parameter

columns.name: REQUEST_RESPONSE_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the request or response type of a service operation parameter

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
